svg.title: Hi, I’m Dev Psalmist
svg.desc: Faded psalm artwork behind the intro: Python Developer | Backend Builder | AI Explorer | Problem Solver. I’m a developer who turns a requirement into a working system: backend APIs, AI-assisted tools, and interfaces that turn messy information into something you can act on. Most of my work is in Python and TypeScript, and I care about clear structure, tests that check something real, and code the next person can pick up.
